descriptions.Statement excerpt: Just last weekend, Russia’s Ministry of Defense satellite COSMOS 2612 exhibited threatening behavior by intentionally maneuvering dangerously close to a commercial satellite. These behaviors appear consistent with an on-orbit weapons operation. The decision to conduct these activities was deliberately reckless and violated long-established safety thresholds in low Earth orbit. The United States believes these maneuvers are being conducted in an unprofessional manner and do not reflect the behavior of a responsible spacefaring nation. We call on Russia to be transparent about what this satellite was doing in orbit.
